You are always off on Wednesday and Thursday. Shifts on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday start nice and early: at 3:00 or 4:00 AM. That way you finish early and have the afternoon free! On Monday and Tuesday, the shift starts at 7:00 or 9:00 in the morning. At HelloFresh, you work with a punch card, and you need safety shoes for this position.
